edges.reason: transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
_to parameter of transfer() flows into the delegated transferFrom call.
_value parameter of transfer() flows into the delegated transferFrom call.
transferFrom() calls ensure() before applying balance updates.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender when checking and decrementing allowance.
transferFrom() reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath, permitting underflow.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath, permitting overflow.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] with unchecked arithmetic.
_from parameter is used for allowance, balance and whitelist checks.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when no whitelist branch matched.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure() bypasses restrictions whenever _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() bypasses restrictions when _from equals the hardcoded UNI router constant.
ensure() bypasses restrictions when _from equals the owner-controlled tradeAddress.
ensure() bypasses restrictions when canSale[_from] is true.
_from parameter is compared against owner, UNI, computed pair and tradeAddress.
_value parameter is forwarded to condition().
_UNI local holds the pairFor() result compared against _from.
condition() reads _saleNum to limit per-address sales.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale counter.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
_value parameter is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale inside condition().
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without restrictions.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve().
_value parameter is the allowance amount written by approve().
delegate() gates the delegatecall solely on require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate() compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall, the critical unsafe operation.
a parameter is the delegatecall target address supplied by the caller.
b parameter is the raw calldata executed by the delegatecall.
Delegatecall executes external code in SpaceDoge storage context, which can re-enter and overwrite owner and mappings.
init() is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
init() compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
init() sets _minSale from the token parameter.
init() sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale.
batchSend() is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() checks msg.sender against the owner state variable.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() reads and writes balanceOf without SafeMath.
batchSend() executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked.
batchSend() executes balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked for each recipient.
_tos array parameter supplies the recipients iterated in batchSend().
_value parameter is the per-recipient amount in batchSend().
_tos.length is a factor of the unchecked total multiplication.
_value is a factor of the unchecked total multiplication.
total local variable holds the unchecked _value * _tos.length product.
total local variable is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
_to local variable indexes the unchecked balance addition.
Loop counter i controls the batchSend() transfer loop and event emission.
setTradeAddress() is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress.
factory parameter feeds the pairFor() CREATE2-style address computation.
tokenA parameter is ordered and hashed inside pairFor().
tokenB parameter is ordered and hashed inside pairFor().
